content: We have retrieved polymorphs for many compositions, saved JSON files per composition in directory sulphide_polymorphs under the workdir. Need to consolidate all individual files into a single comprehensive dataset, each entry should have source_composition. Use consolidate_polymorph_datasets tool. It expects composition_files as a dictionary mapping composition to file path. We have that mapping in result. Need to pass that. Also specify output_path maybe. Let's construct composition_files dict from result. Use the result JSON. We'll feed to consolidate_polymorph_datasets.
